Computer Control beta 5

A browser conversion of Daniel Vincent’s QBASIC parallel-port controller. The program is drawn into a fixed 640×480 framebuffer with 8×16 IBM VGA bitmap characters, the original CP437 box drawing, and the supplied screen text.

The pinout emulates digital logic, including inverted status/control bits. Its control pins model released, open-collector lines. This is a software simulation.

Files, group banks, settings, and recordings stay in this browser. Export .rec and .gro files to keep a separate copy.

The supplied source differs from the released executable. Register initialization, group-bank 4, timing, configuration saving, and scheduler-slot errors are corrected in the port.

DOS executable plug-ins are outside the browser conversion; the Plugins screen supplies a virtual input/output demonstration.
